title: Texas Instruments second-quarter 2026 Form 10-Q
excerpt: Total cash was USD 7.00 billion, inventory was USD 4.61 billion, and days of inventory declined to 196 from 222 at year-end.
summary: The SEC filing hash is unchanged. The Form 10-Q confirms TXN/XNAS identity, USD 7.001 billion cash and short-term investments, USD 14.052 billion debt, USD 4.605 billion inventory, 196 inventory days, USD 2-3 billion expected 2026 capital expenditure and the approximately USD 7.5 billion pending Silicon Labs acquisition funded with cash and debt.
